improvements.reason: Immutable byte stores expose artifact_exists as a typed 409 conflict for the W2 handler rather than an unhandled duplicate-path 500. Existing artifact bytes are preserved.
Local byte publication is atomically create-only under concurrent callers instead of Python's racy exists-then-write sequence. Windows drive, UNC, alternate-stream and backslash escapes are refused.

The API limiter retains depleted buckets until full refill instead of evicting active callers and granting new full allowances through LRU churn. Capacity pressure returns a structured 429 without overspending.

Limiter identity is the original caller oid, as the task specifies, rather than the acting-user oid. All current rate-limited API routes already forbid agents before limiting, so current reachable authorization outcomes remain unchanged.
AI budgets atomically reserve before provider calls instead of a concurrent check-then-record race that can overspend user or overall allowances.
Each physical provider attempt settles usage once, including retries, errors and cancellation, rather than silently omitting retry consumption or double-charging settlement.
Caller-visible tool output, as well as text, prevents retry or provider restart so a partial streamed response cannot be silently replayed.
Total deadlines actively cancel upstream attempts, not just checks between events; cancellation and abandoned streams release resources and preserve accounting.
Trusted fallback facts are supplied separately from reader-controlled prompt markers, preventing forged fences or JSON labels from replacing canonical figures.
Overall budget refusals propagate directly instead of selecting another provider against the same exhausted allowance.
